items.topic: Should BAS integration be a runtime dependency (BAS runs as a sibling scenario and Video Studio calls its API) or a build-time dependency (Video Studio vendors/imports BAS's recording packages directly)?

options.label: Runtime dependency — Video Studio calls BAS's HTTP API (requires BAS running)
Build-time dependency — Import BAS's Go packages directly into Video Studio
Hybrid — Import core recording libs but use BAS API for session management

items.freeform: Runtime dependency is the Vrooli pattern — scenarios depend on other scenarios via their APIs. The spec explicitly says 'Integrate Browser Automation Studio as a scenario dependency.' This keeps BAS as the single owner of Playwright lifecycle and recording logic, and Video Studio gets browser recording by calling BAS endpoints.

items.topic: What is the expected video brief format that agents will submit — free-form text, structured JSON with scene definitions, or a hybrid (text brief that gets parsed into a structured script)?

options.label: Free-form text brief (AI agent interprets and scripts autonomously)
Structured JSON scene manifest (explicit scene list with actions/timings)
Hybrid — accept text brief, AI generates structured script, human reviews script before recording

items.topic: Where should the marketing crew's video opportunity logs be stored so Video Studio can consume them as demand signals?

options.label: decisions.jsonl in marketing-crew shared folder (current pattern)
Dedicated video-requests queue in swarm-manager backlog
Video Studio API endpoint that marketing agents POST briefs to directly

items.freeform: Currently logged as decisions in decisions.jsonl. For P0, Video Studio doesn't need to auto-consume these — a human or marketing-lead agent can manually invoke Video Studio with a brief derived from logged opportunities. For P1, a direct API endpoint makes more sense so the marketing workflow can invoke Video Studio programmatically.

items.topic: Should P0 desktop recording reuse the `resource-ffmpeg screen-capture` CLI (same as S2D) or implement FFmpeg invocation directly within Video Studio?

options.label: Reuse resource-ffmpeg CLI — consistent resource abstraction, less code to maintain
Direct FFmpeg invocation — more control over encoding params, scene-level start/stop
Resource-ffmpeg for capture, direct FFmpeg for compositing/post-processing

items.freeform: Reuse resource-ffmpeg for capture (it already handles display binding, resolution, framerate) but use FFmpeg directly for compositing/post-processing since resource-ffmpeg's screen-capture commands are start/stop oriented and don't cover concat, transitions, or overlay operations.

items.topic: Is P0 success defined as agent-only operation (no human in the loop during production), or is a human-review checkpoint between script generation and recording acceptable?

options.label: Fully autonomous — brief in, video out, human reviews only the final output
Human-in-the-loop — human approves the generated recording script before execution
Configurable — default autonomous with optional human checkpoint

items.freeform: The success criteria say 'human reviews output, not process' — so P0 targets fully autonomous with human review of the final video only. However, a configurable checkpoint makes sense as a safety valve for high-stakes content.
